panels.title: Crossings over time by line & direction

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(event_time, $__interval), camera || ' · ' || coalesce(rule_name,'line') || ' ' || coalesce(direction,'') AS metric, sum(count) AS value
FROM analytics_events WHERE analytic = 'LineCrossing' AND count IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(event_time) AND ('__all' IN ($camera) OR camera IN ($camera)) AND ('__all' IN ($analytic) OR analytic IN ($analytic)) AND ('__all' IN ($rule) OR rule_name IN ($rule))
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT camera, rule_name AS line,
  sum(count) FILTER (WHERE direction='LEFT')  AS "LEFT",
  sum(count) FILTER (WHERE direction='RIGHT') AS "RIGHT",
  sum(count) AS total,
  max(event_time) AS "last crossing"
FROM analytics_events WHERE analytic = 'LineCrossing' AND count IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(event_time) AND ('__all' IN ($camera) OR camera IN ($camera)) AND ('__all' IN ($analytic) OR analytic IN ($analytic)) AND ('__all' IN ($rule) OR rule_name IN ($rule))
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY total DESC

SELECT count(*) AS "Events" FROM analytics_events WHERE analytic <> 'LineCrossing' AND analytic NOT ILIKE '%slip%' AND (state IS NULL OR state <> 'false') AND $__timeFilter(event_time) AND ('__all' IN ($camera) OR camera IN ($camera)) AND ('__all' IN ($analytic) OR analytic IN ($analytic)) AND ('__all' IN ($rule) OR rule_name IN ($rule))

SELECT count(*) AS "Loitering" FROM analytics_events WHERE analytic ILIKE 'loiter%' AND (state IS NULL OR state <> 'false') AND $__timeFilter(event_time) AND ('__all' IN ($camera) OR camera IN ($camera)) AND ('__all' IN ($analytic) OR analytic IN ($analytic)) AND ('__all' IN ($rule) OR rule_name IN ($rule))

SELECT max(event_time) AS "Last" FROM analytics_events WHERE analytic <> 'LineCrossing' AND analytic NOT ILIKE '%slip%' AND ('__all' IN ($camera) OR camera IN ($camera)) AND ('__all' IN ($analytic) OR analytic IN ($analytic)) AND ('__all' IN ($rule) OR rule_name IN ($rule))

SELECT camera, rule_name AS area, analytic AS type,
  count(*) AS events,
